title: Technical Information
text:
System Overview
GB7CAM is a LINBPQ-based licensed packet radio node run by Ian Henry (G0LFT).


RF configuration Notes

Frequency: 144.950 MHz

Mode: AX.25 Packet

Antenna: 5m AGL
Power: ERP 7 dBW (5W)

Location: Harston Cambridge (Grid Squre: JO02AD)




Hardware

Tait 2000 Mk2: a modified commercial radio bought from Simon (G4WQG)
NinoTNC: an amazing little TNC bought from Chris (G1FEF)
Diamond X50: vertical 2m/70cm antenna
Raspbery Pi 4: picked up from the CDARC Bring and Buy for £20




Software

LinBPQ: The core software running Node, BBS, Mail Forwarding and Chat Services
FastAPI: Provides access to node information for the status page
nginx: Reverse proxy for https://node.gb7cam.org.uk and the API
Quarto: Used to create this site



Network

ARDC 44Net: 44Net makes publicly reachable networking available for experimentation and learning. Amateur radio operators and groups use it to run systems that are directly accessible from the Internet using stable public IP addresses.
Wireguard Tunnel: Setup through 44Net Connect
Public Routed Subnet: Assigned by 44Net Connect
AXUDP links to other packet nodes: visit my contact page and drop me a message with your MAP line if you run a node and want to peer

title: Services Available
text:
Services Available
This node runs a LINBPQ and combines Node, BBS, Mail and Chat Services.

NODE
You can connect to the GB7CAM using:
CONNECT <PORT> GB7CAM
The following commands are available:
BBS CHAT CONNECT BYE INFO NODES PORTS ROUTES USERS MHEARD

BBS enters the Buletin Board / Mail System
CHAT enters the Chat System
CONNECT   allows you to connect to another linked node
BYE Exits the node or current connection
INFO Displays the node info message
NODES shows list of nodes you can connect to
PORTS show ports available for communication (PORT 1 - RF 2m, PORT 2 - AXIP)
ROUTES shows routes to other nodes
MHEARD 
USERS shows users currently logged in to the node

Further node information can be found via the linBPQ node page or advanced information on the status page



BBS
To connect to the BBS, first login as above and then type
BBS
Typing HELP will also then give you a full command list.

Only licensed amateur radio operators are allowed to setup and account.
If you have an account you can access your mail via the web using https://node.gb7cam.org.uk/Webmail
If you would like mail or bulletins forwarded to your node just let me know.
The HA of GB7CAM is GB7CAM.#22.GBR.EURO and you can set this to be your home BBS if you wish.




CHAT
To connect to the BBS, first login as above and then type
CHAT
Typing /h will also then give you a full command list.
